This computer is a Mac with 16 GB: run exactly one heavy process at a time, never two test files at once, and keep every run under ten minutes. If your own run is cut short, write what you have into your handoff at once: status IN_PROGRESS, completed_at null, the first issue of kind BLOCKED. ORIGINAL TASK FOLLOWS. The new sweeps take their expected side from a REFERENCE predicate written in the test from the requirement's definitions: judge it (AP-071) - is it an independent reading of the requirement text, or the code's own reading copied? Check with your OWN runs: (1) the criterion -> test mapping for criteria 1-12, any criterion with no test or a weak one; (2) the whole set (bytes, timing, six guard files) on a copy of the whole working tree outside the project in the scratch folder: each file alone in a fresh process and together, at least 3 runs in a row (the timing file alone and not beside other heavy work: the instrument is known to give false reds at about 2x CPU oversubscription, F7 of the previous pass; run nothing heavy beside it), flaky tests, no port, no clock, no order dependence, unique temp folders cleaned; (3) no skip, no todo, no `|| true`, no turned-off lint rule; oracles independent of the code under test (AP-071); no key-shaped literal; the new rows against the RULE text of the requirement (each added row and sweep predicate: is the expected side what the requirement says? the designer reports three own oracle corrections, I1 of step 08k: judge them); (4) failure tests check the state did not change; (5) the criterion 9 numbers recomputed on the final files; (6) regression: the tests fail on a clean copy of the tag base/ISS-0093-20261028-01 with the tests overlaid (no git checkout, reset, stash or clean, also not in copies); (7) apply mutants YOURSELF on a copy outside the project: at least ten of the design's m1-m45, the nine mutants x54, y22-y25, y19, y20, z01b, z02 of step 08l and the seven of step 08j (they must now be red), and at least TWENTY-FIVE NEW mutants of your own that are not in any earlier report, chosen by the CLASS of each rule of forms F1-F9 and of the placeholder rules (every rule stated as «starts with», «ends with», «the whole value», «only of», «optional one», «a run of», «without regard to case», «at least n», «at most n», a boundary character): for each rule try its looser and its tighter neighbour (contains, first k, last k, exactly one, any number, off-by-one in a count, case-sensitive); report which test kills each and every survivor; (8) the criterion 7 instrument: time of the timing file alone, thresholds unchanged, the control separated, the early abandonment equal to the median rule; (9) the deviations: criterion 7 in a second file, scenario-files.json edited (EX-51 row), the amended criteria 1 and 7, TM-57 split. result.summary: Тесты стали намного крепче: 165 тестов зелёные три раза подряд (файл с цепочками на 140 с, файл замеров на 94 с из 120), на чистой копии метки красны 11 охранных тестов и оба новых файла, а из 29 мутантов проекта, 16 мутантов двух прошлых проходов и моих 68 новых красны все, кроме двух: один из них равнозначен (список имён уже защищён порогом длины), а один настоящий. Шаг всё же не проходит (пункт 3 роли): если точка стоит слева от eyJ (x.eyJ... и .eyJ... из трёх частей), настоящий код правильно хранит строку, как требует определение отрезка из четырёх частей, но мутант «точка слева от eyJ - граница» живёт при 55 из 55 зелёных тестах, потому что в сквозном ряду XJ1 знак «.» вырезан фильтром с ошибочной оговоркой «требование молчит». Это третий дополнительный проход (решение 0102, дополнение 15), поэтому решает владелец: код чинить не нужно, достаточно убрать один фильтр в XJ1 и добавить две строки.

findings.where: tools/test/team-result-bytes.test.js, sweep XJ1 (line with CHARS_X.filter((x) => x !== ".")) and rows O32 (form F7, the character to the left of eyJ); result.issues I2 point 2 of step 08m; role item 3; AP-110, AP-014
findings.what: The slot to the left of eyJ is swept over all characters except the dot, on the claim that the requirement is silent. It is not silent: F7 defines the segment as a run of [A-Za-z0-9_.-], 'exactly three non-empty parts, the first begins with eyJ'. A run 'x.eyJ<a>.<b>.<c>' or '.eyJ<a>.<b>.<c>' has four parts, so it is stored; the real code stores it (checked: x.+three-part sample, .+three-part sample and a.b.+eyJa.b.c all give null). My mutant t31 (a dot to the left of eyJ is a boundary, i.e. the line 'if (at > 0 && findIsRunChar(prev)) continue;' also lets a dot through) survives the whole bytes file (55 of 55 green, 144 s) and the fast subset (10 of 10). Real code and mutant differ on 'x.' + the three-part sample, '.' + the three-part sample, 'a.b.eyJa.b.c' (stored by the real code, F7 by the mutant). O32 holds x _ 9 - only. This is the same class that the task of 08m named (the slot before the item, 128 ASCII + others): one character of the slot was left out.
findings.fix: TEST-DESIGNER, tests only: remove the filter in XJ1 so the slot takes every character (the reference already gives 'stored' for the dot: isRun('.') is true and the run has four parts), add '.' to O32 as a stored row and keep the whole three-part sample as the refused partner (C6). Then t31 must be red; also rerun the generator class 'left boundary: one character of the run set let through' for the other 'left of the item' slots (F4-F6 are covered by XK*l, F8 by XE2).

findings.where: reference of the exhaustive sweeps (isAlnum / KEY_FAMILIES in the X block); result.issues I2 of step 08m
findings.what: For F4-F6 the requirement says 'слева не буква и не цифра' and, for F5, only 'не менее 20 знаков' with no character set. The reference takes the ASCII reading and the body sets [A-Za-z0-9] (gh), [A-Za-z0-9_] (github_pat_) from the old rules M4-M6 (base mask.js lines 92-95), so a letter or a digit outside ASCII to the left of a key counts as a boundary (the key is refused: checked for the letter e-acute and an Arabic-Indic digit). That is the safe side and 'Ф5 (M5)' points to M5, so it is a defensible reading, but it is the code's predecessor, not the requirement text, and the designer's list of silent positions does not name it.
findings.fix: Not blocking. Put the two quoted places into result.issues of the next step as 'silent: the reading follows the old rules M4-M6' so a later reader does not take them for the requirement's words.

findings.what: A mutant that makes about half of the 393,699 sweep rows wrong (m3: findSecrets always null; m4 for F9) does not end with a normal failure: the file process was killed with SIGKILL after about 21 s (the TAP shows signal SIGKILL, no failing test name). I did not measure memory; the likely cause is the diff of a list with hundreds of thousands of strings built by deepEqual. The mutant still counts as red, but the machine has crashed before from memory pressure, and a loud mutant must end in a short message.
findings.fix: Not blocking. Compare wrong.length first and put only the first 20 entries into the message (wrong.slice(0, 20)).
